source.title: Solise - Floral Wonder
source.name: Solise
source.description: A gentle but strong-minded Mage with a deep bond to nature, able to channel both healing and offensive magic at will.

skills.name: Life's Embrace

description.raw: Solise enters a nature-attuned state, releasing 3 waves of healing across the battlefield that each restores 140% (ATK-based) + 22% (SP-based) HP to affected allies. If an allied Bulbsprite is affected by one of her healing waves, it sends a water ring from its host' position, dealing 30% (ATK-based) + 3% (SP-based) damage to all enemies. Solide becomes unaffected while casting this skill.
active: Solise enters a nature-attuned state, releasing 3 waves of healing across the battlefield that each restores 140% (ATK-based) + 22% (SP-based) HP to affected allies.
If an allied Bulbsprite is affected by one of her healing waves, it sends a water ring from its host' position, dealing 30% (ATK-based) + 3% (SP-based) damage to all enemies.
Solide becomes unaffected while casting this skill.

skills.description_lite: Solise chants a spell to continuously heal all allies. Affected Bulbsprites will deal damage to all enemies.

skills.name: Lifebloom Buds

description.raw: When a battle starts, Solise sends a Bulb to each non-summoned ally, blessing them with nature's gift. These Bulbs provide 40% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) healing to their host every 3s. Solise becomes unaffected while casting this skill. During battle, each Bulb can store any excess healing its host receives. When this stores healing reaches 600% of Solise's initial ATK, the Bulb blooms into a Bulbsprite. The Bulbsprite permanently increases its host's ATK by a value equal to 15% + 1.5% (SP-based) of Solise' initial ATK. Even when Solise is defeated in battle, the effects from her Bulbs and Bulbsprites stay active. But they can't grow or respond to her anymore.

text: Increases the healing provided by a Bulb to 60% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based).
Increases the healing provided by a Bulb to 80% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based).
Increases the healing provided by a Bulb to 100% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based).

skills.description_lite: Solise sends a Bulb to each non-summoned ally. When certain conditions are met, the Bulb will bloom into a Bulbsprite. In either form, it continuously heals its host and grants buffs.

skills.name: Floral Favor

description.raw: Solise infuses her magic into potions to help restore 190% (ATK-based) + 25% (SP-based) HP to the weakest 2 allies. When Solise heals an ally who already has a Bulbsprite with them, her healing grants a permanent shield that absorbs 250% (ATK-based) + 25% (SP-based) damage. The shield value cannot exceed 900% (ATK-based).
active: Solise infuses her magic into potions to help restore 190% (ATK-based) + 25% (SP-based) HP to the weakest 2 allies.
When Solise heals an ally who already has a Bulbsprite with them, her healing grants a permanent shield that absorbs 250% (ATK-based) + 25% (SP-based) damage.
The shield value cannot exceed 900% (ATK-based).

skills.description_lite: Solise heals the weakest allies. If a healed ally has a Bulbsprite with them, they also gain a shield.

skills.name: Hero Focus

description.raw: Increases ATK by 10% during battle. Gains an extra 5% ATK when an allied Bulbsprite is present.

Gains an extra 5% ATK when an allied Bulbsprite is present.

text: Gains an extra 8% ATK when an allied Bulbsprite is present.
Gains an extra 11% ATK when an allied Bulbsprite is present.

skills.description_lite: Increases ATK, with an extra ATK increase when a Bulbsprite is present.

skills.name: Resonant Bloom

description.raw: When a Bulb blooms into a Bulbsprite, it grants its host a permanent blessing, increasing their Phys & Magic DEF by a value equal to 4% of Solise's initial ATK. When the total excess healing a Bulbsprite's host receives reaches 600% of Solise's initial ATK, the Bulbsprite permanently levels up, and its host gains ATK equal to 7% of Solise's initial ATK. The Bulbsprite can be upgraded this way up to 3 times.

skills.name: Enhance Force

description.raw: While Solise is casting Life's Embrace, damage dealt by Bulbsprite triggers extra damage equal to 2% of the total excess healing it has stored during its Bulbsprite phase. The extra damage cannot exceed 110% of Solise's initial ATK.
